description: Look up a known MSHA Mine ID: current status, type, commodity, operator and controller, plus recent inspections, recent violations (with assessed penalties, S&S flag, and abatement/termination dates), and recent quarterly employment and coal production. Violations/inspections/production cover only the most recent 5 calendar years (the response says so) — MSHA's full history back to 2000 is not loaded. Sourced from MSHA's own bulk mine-records files (public domain), refreshed weekly. Keyless.

inspections_limit.description: Max recent inspections to return (default 10, max 50).

mine_id.description: MSHA Mine ID, e.g. "4608254". Find it with msha_mine_search if you only have an operator/mine name.

violations_limit.description: Max recent violations to return (default 20, max 100).

name: msha_mine_detail
title: Msha Mine Detail
